# Design Guidance

Clean, direct, and purposeful design is essential for creating effective user experiences. Focus on simplicity, clarity, and functionality to ensure that users can easily navigate and interact with your product. Use consistent visual elements, intuitive layouts, and clear calls to action to guide users through their journey. Prioritize accessibility and inclusivity to make your design usable for a diverse audience.

Say less, do more. Avoid unnecessary complexity and clutter in your design. Every element should serve a purpose and contribute to the overall user experience. Use whitespace effectively to create a sense of balance and focus attention on key elements.
